title: Delivery order on the way
description: Tell customers their food order left the kitchen with a live ETA. Shipping update WhatsApp template for restaurant delivery.
notes: Keep the ETA in minutes and the order number visible. Do not add upsells, which would reclassify it.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your order *#{{order_id}}* from {{restaurant}} is on its way and should arrive in about {{eta}} minutes.
